item.title: Global Secure Access custom headers now require Web Filtering v2 policies — 17 September 2026
item.description:
Day in brief · 17 September 2026

Global Secure Access custom headers now require Web Filtering v2 policies

The period was documentation-led, with the most consequential change clarifying that Global Secure Access custom headers are available only with Web Filtering (v2) policies. Related web content-filtering guidance removed “preview” labels from two condition types, while SSPR guidance adopted updated administrator terminology.

Global Secure Access · General

Custom HTTP headers guidance names a Web Filtering v2 prerequisite

The Global Secure Access guidance now states that custom headers are available only with Web Filtering (v2) policies and links to related guidance. Administrators configuring custom headers must account for that prerequisite.

Internet Access · Conditional Access

Web content-filtering guidance removes preview labels from two conditions

The guidance removes “preview” from the source traffic type and HTTP method request filtering conditions, updates their headings and links, and refreshes the page date. Internal references using the former labels should be updated.

Entra ID · Authentication

SSPR policy guidance adopts Microsoft Entra administrator terminology

The SSPR policy page now uses “Microsoft Entra administrators” instead of “Azure administrators.”

item.title: Microsoft-provided SMS and voice authentication face phased 2027 retirement deadlines — 16 September 2026
item.description:
Day in brief · 16 September 2026

Microsoft-provided SMS and voice authentication face phased 2027 retirement deadlines

The strongest Entra guidance this period sets a February 1, 2027 retirement for Microsoft-provided SMS and voice authentication for users including internal guests, with Global Administrators and external users on July 1, 2027. Users relying only on those methods will receive a blocking passkey-registration prompt after their applicable deadline. Microsoft also added practical Cloud Sync migration and Connect Sync passwordless sign-in procedures, while most remaining activity involved Connect release-history, navigation, and command-path cleanup.

Entra ID · Authentication

Phased retirement guidance gives SMS and voice two deadlines

The authentication guidance states that Microsoft-provided SMS and voice retire February 1, 2027, for users including internal guests. Global Administrators and external users follow July 1, 2027; after the applicable date, users whose only MFA method is SMS or voice receive a blocking passkey-registration prompt. Administrators should move them to phishing-resistant methods or configure a customer-managed telecom provider where needed.

Entra ID · General

Connect version guidance now identifies 2.6.91.0 as latest

The version history replaces references to 2.6.90.0 with 2.6.91.0 and identifies 2.6.91.0 as the latest available version. Upgrades involving an existing ADSync database should use 2.6.91.0 or later, while installations of recalled version 2.6.79.0 should be uninstalled and replaced with 2.6.91.0.

Entra ID · Provisioning

Cloud Sync migration guidance documents staged assessment and validation

A new article covers using the guided migration tool to assess an environment, create Cloud Sync configurations, run a preactivation check, and validate synchronization after migration. It also identifies required roles, credentials, eligibility limits, supported scenarios, and a two-week validation process.

Entra ID · Authentication

Connect Sync gets a documented FIDO2 and passkey sign-in path

A new how-to explains how to enable FIDO2 and passkey methods, register credentials, configure a registry setting, and sign into Microsoft Entra Connect Sync without a password. The procedure gives administrators a documented passwordless setup path for synchronization installations and configuration.

Entra ID · Authentication

Windows SSPR guidance moves from OMA-URI to Settings Catalog

The revised procedure replaces the custom OMA-URI profile process with an Intune Settings Catalog policy. Administrators now select Authentication > Allow Aad Password Reset and set the value to Allow.

View all updates for 16 September 2026 →

item.title: Passkeys are now Entra’s default as Microsoft-provided SMS and voice retire — 15 September 2026
item.description:
Day in brief · 15 September 2026

Passkeys are now Entra’s default as Microsoft-provided SMS and voice retire

The period’s main operational change is an authentication transition: passkeys became the default Microsoft Entra authentication on September 1, 2026, while Microsoft-provided SMS and voice authentication will retire on February 1, 2027. Other updates are targeted guidance for External ID browser authentication, registration campaigns, and HR provisioning null-value handling.

Entra ID · Conditional Access

Microsoft-provided SMS and voice authentication face a February 2027 retirement

Passkeys became the default Microsoft Entra authentication on September 1, 2026. Microsoft-provided SMS and voice authentication will retire on February 1, 2027, after which customers must use telecom providers from the Microsoft Security Store. Microsoft recommends transitioning to passkeys for phishing-resistant security.

External ID · Authentication

External ID guidance documents system-browser handoff for brokered identity providers

The new guidance describes handing external-IdP authentication from an embedded WebView to the system browser, enabling external-IdP passkeys, browser SSO, and identity providers that block WebViews. It lists the required platform, broker, application-version, federation-protocol, and cloud-support considerations.

Entra ID · Authentication

Registration Campaign guidance separates managed and enabled campaign requirements

The updated guidance distinguishes Microsoft-managed from enabled campaigns, specifies the MFA method required for each targeted authentication method, and broadens eligible users from those signing in with SMS or voice to users signing in with any MFA method.

Entra ID · Provisioning

HR provisioning preview adds clearing for emptied Workday and SAP values

Preview guidance covers clearing mapped target attributes when Workday or SAP SuccessFactors inbound provisioning returns null or empty values, with configuration, schema, testing, and troubleshooting material for the behavior.

Entra ID · Troubleshooting

HR provisioning guidance makes the dual Flow null values requirement explicit

Target attributes are cleared only when Flow null values is enabled for both the source attribute and the target mapping. The updated guidance also documents choices to clear, preserve, or replace empty values.

View all updates for 15 September 2026 →

item.title: Enterprise State Roaming shifts to Windows policies as Entra passkeys expand — 14 September 2026
item.description:
Day in brief · 14 September 2026

Enterprise State Roaming shifts to Windows policies as Entra passkeys expand

The period’s strongest administrator change is the move of Enterprise State Roaming management out of the Entra admin center, alongside two scheduled passkey rollouts beginning in October 2026. Microsoft also tightened self-service App Gallery onboarding guidance for v1 endpoint applications and expanded Account Discovery guidance to groups, with preview and matching-attribute limitations. Most remaining edits refine licensing, troubleshooting, and operational requirements, including Private Access alert eligibility.

Entra ID · General

Enterprise State Roaming management moves to Windows policies

As of July 2026, Enterprise State Roaming can no longer be managed in the Microsoft Entra admin center. Administrators must use Windows settings backup and restore policies; supported settings remain unchanged, and existing controls are honored for one year.

Entra ID · Conditional Access

B2B users gain resource-tenant passkey registration and sign-in

The announced rollout starts in October 2026 and will let B2B users register and sign in with resource-tenant passkeys for phishing-resistant MFA. Eligible users will be enabled automatically.

Entra ID · Conditional Access

Passkeys can become a user’s first multifactor method

A phased rollout from October 2026 through February 2027 will allow users to register passkeys or passwordless sign-in as their first MFA method, removing the need to set up weaker methods first.

Entra ID · General

Self-service App Gallery validation excludes v1 endpoint applications

Applications using Microsoft identity platform v1 endpoints cannot be validated through self-service App Gallery onboarding. The guidance recommends migrating those applications to v2 endpoints before validation.

Entra ID · Governance

Account Discovery guidance adds group coverage with preview limits

The updated guidance covers users and groups, classifying identities as local, unassigned, or assigned. Group discovery is in preview, and correlation requires a direct matching attribute.

View all updates for 14 September 2026 →

item.title: Purview DLP targets network-level file filtering for Entra Internet Access — 11 September 2026
item.description:
Day in brief · 11 September 2026

Purview DLP targets network-level file filtering for Entra Internet Access

Purview DLP is being integrated with Entra Global Secure Access Internet Access to filter sensitive files at the network layer and prevent leaks to unmanaged cloud apps; the announcement lists public preview from mid-November 2025 and general availability by October 2026. Entra is also retiring legacy app-launcher and My Staff feature settings, while External ID consolidates identity-provider setup into a central user-flow procedure. Most remaining changes are documentation consolidation, Copilot naming cleanup, and more explicit integration guidance.

Internet Access · Conditional Access

Purview DLP pairs with Entra Internet Access for network-layer file filtering

The Message Center announcement describes filtering sensitive files at the network layer to prevent data leaks to unmanaged cloud apps. It lists public preview from mid-November 2025 and general availability by October 2026; deployment requires policies, TLS inspection, and Purview pay-as-you-go activation.

Entra ID · Developer

Legacy app-launcher settings no longer affect user behavior

The documentation now states that legacy preview and experience settings no longer affect app launchers or user behavior and are being removed from the Microsoft Entra admin center. Administrators should use application assignments and My Apps collections to control visibility.

Entra ID · General

My Staff access now follows roles and administrative-unit scope

My Staff access is now determined by administrative role assignments and their administrative-unit scope. The legacy controls under Manage user feature settings no longer affect behavior and are being removed.

External ID · Authentication

External ID centralizes identity-provider setup in one user-flow procedure

A new central article documents how to add configured OIDC, SAML/WS-Fed, or social identity providers to an External ID user flow, including prerequisites, permissions, portal steps, and testing.

Workload ID · Authentication

SAP SuccessFactors workload identity guidance adds explicit prerequisites

The integration guide now spells out required Microsoft Entra and SAP permissions, SAP IAS OIDC and JWT Trust-by-Issuer configuration, and the token flow and revocation process. Administrators should review these requirements before configuring the integration.

View all updates for 11 September 2026 →

item.title: Passkey guidance now points applications to Microsoft Graph FIDO2 provisioning APIs — 10 September 2026
item.description:
Day in brief · 10 September 2026

Passkey guidance now points applications to Microsoft Graph FIDO2 provisioning APIs

External ID’s passkey-management guidance now directs applications away from the preview credential management API and toward Microsoft Graph FIDO2 provisioning APIs, while identifying low-privilege passkey APIs as roadmap work. A related credential-management API reference was removed, and the device code flow exclusion procedure now uses a more specific resource-selection path.

External ID · Authentication

External ID passkey guidance replaces preview API direction

The Sign In With Passkey page no longer directs applications to the preview credential management API. It now recommends Microsoft Graph FIDO2 provisioning APIs and says low-privilege passkey credential-management APIs are on the roadmap. No immediate administrator action is stated.

Entra ID · Security

Credential management API reference is removed

The Microsoft Entra External ID credential management API reference was deleted; it had covered listing, registering, and deleting passkeys for signed-in customers. Use the redirected Microsoft Graph documentation and update internal links or bookmarks that point to the old page.

Entra ID · Monitoring

Device code flow exclusions now use specific resource selection

The policy procedure now directs administrators through Exclude > Select resources > Select specific resources before adding Device Registration Service. Follow this path when configuring the exclusion, which the guide says is required to prevent device registration through device code flow from being blocked.

View all updates for 10 September 2026 →

item.title: Verified ID setup limits and DUSI tracing sharpen Microsoft Entra administration — 8 September 2026
item.description:
Day in brief · 8 September 2026

Verified ID setup limits and DUSI tracing sharpen Microsoft Entra administration

The period’s substantive updates center on a newly published Microsoft Entra Verified ID setup article, clearer trust behavior for B2B direct connect, and DUSI-based correlation of sign-ins with administrative activity. The remaining change is a low-impact Workload ID example correction that changes “GitHub Actions” to take the singular verb “needs”; no administrator action is stated.

External ID · Security

Verified ID setup guidance documents prerequisites and operating limits

The new External ID article covers Quick setup, application registration, credential creation, and credential issuance and verification. It also documents required roles, custom-domain requirements, shared signing keys, a limit of two requests per second per tenant, and six-month credential validity.

External ID · General

B2B direct connect guidance explains external device-claim trust

The updated guidance explains how Microsoft Entra ID accepts compliant-device claims from an external user’s home tenant, how Conditional Access evaluates those claims, the trust implications, and the behavior when the setting is disabled.

Entra ID · Authentication

DUSI guidance connects sign-ins with administrative activity

Supported audit events can include DUSI, with the guidance mapping linkable identifiers to audit-log attributes and providing steps to correlate sign-ins with administrative activity. Some events may not include DUSI.

View all updates for 8 September 2026 →

item.title: Passkey campaign states and granular SCIM permissions sharpen Entra guidance — 5 September 2026
item.description:
Day in brief · 5 September 2026

Passkey campaign states and granular SCIM permissions sharpen Entra guidance

September 5 was documentation-led: all nine supplied entries were updates, with no new or removed items and no Message Center notices. The substantive guidance covers passkey and Authenticator registration campaigns, SCIM query and permission design, and a Workload ID namespace distinction. The remaining edits are mostly link, schema, and reference maintenance.

Entra ID · Authentication

Registration campaign guidance now defines three campaign states

The Entra ID guidance describes Microsoft managed, Enabled, and Disabled states, along with method-specific eligibility and prompting conditions. It also lists prerequisites for Authenticator and passkey campaigns and says the updated experience is rolling out through the end of September 2026, so tenant behavior may vary during rollout.

Entra ID · Standards

SCIM reference documents 999-user pages and additional filters

The reference documents up to 999 users per page when the projection excludes the manager attribute. It also covers filters for active users, negated suffix matches, group membership, and group ownership.

Entra ID · Standards

SCIM permissions guidance maps least privilege to operations

The reference adds operation-specific permissions for basic user reads, user creation and updates, group creation and membership changes, and selected user attributes. Provisioning applications can align consent more closely with the operations their workflows perform.

Entra ID · Standards

SCIM schema guidance limits ownership attributes to filtering

User:ownedGroups and Group:owners are documented as read-only, multi-valued attributes. Their IDs can be used in filter queries but are never returned in response bodies; the page also corrects the groups members.value response-body description.

Workload ID · General

Managed-identity restriction guidance separates API and portal namespaces

Workload ID guidance says Azure CLI commands and infrastructure-as-code templates must use Microsoft.Storage. Microsoft.Storage/* is only the Azure portal display convention and is not accepted by the API.

View all updates for 5 September 2026 →

item.description:
Day in brief · 4 September 2026

Entra adds SOC Identity Responder as passkey registration optimization rolls out

The period brings a meaningful Entra role addition and a live passkey-registration rollout, plus new HiBob-to-Active Directory hybrid provisioning guidance. Remaining updates sharpen permissions and recovery boundaries: Security Administrator references diverge on identity containment, while Agent ID sponsors cannot restore resources they disable or delete.

Entra ID · General

Entra SOC Identity Responder gets explicit containment permissions

The permissions reference documents the Entra SOC Identity Responder role for SOC incident response, including disabling users, revoking active sign-in sessions, and resetting passwords.

Entra ID · Authentication

Passkey registration optimization runs through mid-September

Microsoft Entra will better follow administrator policies, prioritize local-device passkeys, and improve successful registration without UI changes. The rollout began in late August 2026 and is scheduled to complete by mid-September; no action is required.

Entra ID · Provisioning

New HiBob guidance connects Entra provisioning to on-premises AD

New guidance covers HiBob provisioning and updating users in on-premises Active Directory through Entra API-driven provisioning and the provisioning agent, including prerequisites, permissions, connection setup, and synchronization flow.

Entra ID · Authentication

Security Administrator containment guidance now needs reconciliation

One updated permissions reference describes Security Administrators as reading security information and reports and managing Entra ID and Office 365 configuration while removing identity-containment language; another same-day update says the role can perform containment actions. A separate role table limits the role to non-administrative accounts and excludes action on privileged accounts.

Agent ID · Governance

Agent ID sponsors cannot restore identities they disable

Sponsors can disable agent identities, modify sponsors, and soft-delete resources, but cannot enable or restore agent blueprints or identities. Owners or administrators must handle recovery.

item.title: MCP server protection and a 98% managed-identity quota threshold anchor Entra guidance — 3 September 2026
item.description:
Day in brief · 3 September 2026

MCP server protection and a 98% managed-identity quota threshold anchor Entra guidance

The strongest changes are new implementation guidance for securing Model Context Protocol servers with Microsoft Entra ID and integrating Entitlement Management with ServiceNow. The period also adds a specific managed-identity creation limit at 98% of tenant directory quota, improves PIM audit correlation guidance, and clarifies the Partner One ID requirement for App Gallery publishers. The passkey page now omits “(preview)” from its title and heading, with the supplied evidence indicating a label change.

Entra ID · Standards

New MCP server protection procedure uses Entra OAuth and Agent ID

A new Entra ID how-to explains registering an MCP server as an OAuth 2.0 protected resource, enabling v2 access tokens, and connecting MCP clients through Microsoft Entra Agent ID. An app registration with required permissions and an HTTPS MCP server are prerequisites.

Entra ID · Governance

Entitlement Management documents ServiceNow access-package workflows

New guidance covers ServiceNow access package requests, request history, and approvals, along with installation, configuration, licensing, and user workflows. Microsoft Entra ID Entitlement Management remains the system of record, and a Microsoft Entra ID P2 or Microsoft Entra Suite license is required.

Workload ID · General

Managed identity creation is blocked at 98% directory quota usage

The updated guidance states that creating a managed identity is blocked when directory usage reaches or exceeds 98% of the tenant quota, including for new or recreated service principals. Existing identities and assignments continue to work; soft-deleted objects count toward the quota, and reducing usage or increasing the quota enables retries.

ID Governance · Governance

PIM audit tracing now pivots on roleAssignmentRequestId

Related PIM activation and deactivation events can have different CorrelationId values. The updated audit-log guidance recommends roleAssignmentRequestId for tracing a complete request and adds Log Analytics query examples.

Entra ID · Developer

App Gallery publishing guidance now requires the Partner One ID

The publishing prerequisites now instruct app publishers to provide a Partner One ID associated with the Microsoft AI Cloud Partner Program organization listed as the publisher, and explain where to get help if the identifier is unknown.

item.title: Viva Engage will require Entra permissions as Global Secure Access adds TLS certificate guidance — 1 September 2026
item.description:
Day in brief · 1 September 2026

Viva Engage will require Entra permissions as Global Secure Access adds TLS certificate guidance

Microsoft’s clearest administrator-impacting change is a late-September Viva Engage authorization update: community and membership management will require the Microsoft Entra Yammer Administrator role or a Community Admin assignment, replacing access previously available to Verified or Network Admins. Global Secure Access guidance now covers both certificate paths for TLS inspection, including a preview Microsoft-managed root CA workflow and a clarified customer-provided CA procedure. An iOS Authenticator passkey-restore improvement is scheduled worldwide for mid-September with no policy changes or required administrator action. Remaining entries are mainly documentation maintenance involving links, screenshots, URLs, download IDs, spacing, and troubleshooting text.

Entra ID · Security

Viva Engage is changing community and membership administration permissions

Starting late September 2026, community and membership management tasks will require the Microsoft Entra Yammer Administrator role or a Community Admin assignment. The requirement applies to tasks previously available to Verified or Network Admins.

Global Secure Access · Security

Global Secure Access documents Microsoft-managed root CA setup in preview

A new preview guide describes creating a tenant-specific Microsoft-managed root CA, deploying its public certificate to client devices, and then enabling it for Microsoft Entra Internet Access TLS inspection. Microsoft protects the private key.

Global Secure Access · Security

Customer-provided TLS certificate workflow is now explicitly documented

The updated Global Secure Access guide focuses on bringing your own certificate authority, including CSR creation, PKI signing, and certificate upload, and links to separate Microsoft-managed certificate guidance.

Entra ID · Authentication

Authenticator adds a guided iOS passkey restore flow

Microsoft says the iOS Microsoft Authenticator app will receive a clearer, guided device-migration flow for passkey restoration worldwide in mid-September 2026. The change affects users with iCloud backup and includes updated user guidance without policy changes.

View all updates for 1 September 2026 →

item.title: Cloud Sync group provisioning guidance shifts to focused AD DS workflows and constraints — 31 August 2026
item.description:
Day in brief · 31 August 2026

Cloud Sync group provisioning guidance shifts to focused AD DS workflows and constraints

The period is dominated by a substantial restructuring of Microsoft Entra Cloud Sync guidance for provisioning groups to Active Directory. Microsoft added a dedicated AD DS tutorial, rewrote setup and testing material, documented tighter topology requirements, and removed seven older pages covering combined provisioning, prerequisites, deployment options, and test-and-enable procedures. Separately, Global Secure Access guidance now describes preview custom HTTP headers through Web Content Filtering v2 rules.

Entra ID · Provisioning

Cloud Sync adds a dedicated group-provisioning tutorial for AD DS

The new tutorial covers provisioning groups to on-premises Active Directory Domain Services in both Entra-to-AD and AD-to-Entra scenarios, including how source of authority and membership affect provisioning. It recommends Selected security groups as the default scoping filter to help prevent performance issues.

Entra ID · Provisioning

Cloud Sync topology guidance specifies group membership and identifier requirements

The guidance now states that cloud-synced groups can contain only on-premises synchronized users and additional cloud-created security groups, and that all users must have `onPremisesObjectIdentifier`.

Entra ID · Provisioning

On-demand provisioning tests now select groups and up to five members

The revised procedure instructs administrators to select a group and up to five members for testing. User-specific instructions and result-review details were removed, and references were updated for provisioning from Microsoft Entra ID to Active Directory.

Entra ID · Provisioning

Cloud Sync test-and-enable reference guidance has been removed

The former how-to page for testing and enabling Entra-to-Active Directory provisioning was deleted. It had covered on-demand tests, default properties, enabling configurations, quarantines, restarting synchronization, and removing configurations.

Global Secure Access · General

Global Secure Access guidance documents preview custom HTTP headers

New guidance describes adding custom HTTP headers to matching outbound web requests through Web Content Filtering v2 rules, including tenant restrictions and other header-aware services. TLS inspection and the documented Global Secure Access prerequisites are required.

View all updates for 31 August 2026 →

item.title: App Gallery SCIM publishing guidance adds a 25-test Logic Apps validation workflow — 29 August 2026
item.description:
Day in brief · 29 August 2026

App Gallery SCIM publishing guidance adds a 25-test Logic Apps validation workflow

Microsoft published new preview guidance for validating SCIM user and group provisioning before Microsoft Entra App Gallery review. The workflow uses an Azure Logic Apps template, runs 25 tests, and requires submission of the results with a Logic App run ID. Related guidance now distinguishes ordinary SCIM endpoint testing from the validation evidence required for App Gallery publishing. Global Secure Access guidance separately flags version 1.5.612.0 or earlier as unsupported and recommends immediate updating. Most remaining changes were metadata, navigation, and cross-linking edits.

Entra ID · Standards

Preview guidance defines the App Gallery validation workflow

The new guide explains how to validate SCIM user and group provisioning with an Azure Logic Apps template, run 25 tests, and submit the results with a Logic App run ID for App Gallery review. It documents both AI-agent and Azure portal setup methods.

Entra ID · Standards

SCIM Validator guidance separates endpoint tests from gallery evidence

The updated tutorial says the Microsoft Entra SCIM Validator is for endpoint testing, while App Gallery publishing requires running the Azure Logic Apps validation template and submitting its results.

Entra ID · Standards

Portal instructions add the provisioning test-app setup sequence

The new setup guide covers creating an Entra Gallery Provisioning Test App, deploying the Azure Logic Apps validation template, configuring permissions and parameters, and running SCIM provisioning tests. It also points supporting teams to a verified tenant domain and Azure PowerShell or CLI workflow.

Entra ID · Standards

Troubleshooting guidance covers failed Logic Apps validation runs

A companion preview article explains how to inspect failed validation runs and address common SCIM endpoint, authentication, permissions, filtering, and conflict errors before submission.

Global Secure Access · General

Global Secure Access flags older client versions for immediate updates

The version-history guidance now uses an “Unsupported versions” section and recommends immediately updating Global Secure Access version 1.5.612.0 or earlier to a newer version.

item.title: Cloud-to-AD provisioning guidance separates generally available groups from preview users — 28 August 2026
item.description:
Day in brief · 28 August 2026

Cloud-to-AD provisioning guidance separates generally available groups from preview users

Microsoft Entra’s Cloud Sync material now forms an end-to-end guide for provisioning users, groups, and memberships from Entra ID to on-premises AD DS. The new overview labels group provisioning generally available and user provisioning preview; companion guidance covers groups-only, users-only, and users-and-groups scoping, limits, filters, mappings, performance, prerequisites, and on-demand testing. A separate preview procedure preserves a group’s original distinguished name with a GroupDN directory extension when its source of authority changes to Microsoft Entra ID. Elsewhere, Global Secure Access marks four versions deprecated and tells users of version 1.5.612.0 or earlier to update immediately. Cloud Sync guidance also removes the obsolete Repair-AADCloudSyncToolsAccount procedure, while Conditional Access guidance states that Android Authenticator uses Google Play Integrity for jailbreak detection and denies requests when the API is unavailable unless the policy is disabled. Most remaining changes are routine example-ID, link, and reference maintenance.

Entra ID · Fundamentals

Cloud Sync overview sets group GA and user preview boundaries

The new overview covers provisioning users, groups, and memberships from Microsoft Entra ID to on-premises AD, including supported scenarios, configuration options, synchronization behavior, and limitations. It explicitly states that group provisioning is generally available while user provisioning is in preview.

Entra ID · Fundamentals

Three provisioning scopes are documented with filters and limits

The preview guidance compares groups-only, users-only, and users-and-groups provisioning through scoping filters. It also records availability, domain and tenant configuration limits, and performance guidance to help administrators choose an appropriate scope and avoid unnecessary processing.

Entra ID · Provisioning

On-demand testing can validate objects before broad synchronization

The new testing guide covers testing users or groups on demand, reviewing safeguards and notifications, enabling configurations, handling quarantines, restarting synchronization, and removing configurations. A group test can include up to five members.

Entra ID · General

GroupDN setup preserves distinguished names across source-of-authority changes

The preview how-to explains how to create and populate a GroupDN directory extension so a group’s original distinguished name is retained when its source of authority changes to Microsoft Entra ID. The one-time setup includes Universal scope, extension creation, and attribute mapping.

Global Secure Access · General

Global Secure Access version history marks four versions deprecated

Versions 1.5.612.0, 1.5.402.0, 1.5.132.0, and 1.5.36.0 are marked deprecated. Users of version 1.5.612.0 or earlier are instructed to update immediately.

View all updates for 28 August 2026 →

item.title: LES Writeback, Android Play Integrity, and SCIM mailNickname rules sharpen Entra guidance — 27 August 2026
item.description:
Day in brief · 27 August 2026

LES Writeback, Android Play Integrity, and SCIM mailNickname rules sharpen Entra guidance

The period was dominated by ordinary documentation maintenance—sample GUIDs, example identifiers, a corrected link, and PowerShell example syntax. The substantive updates were clearer Conditional Access guidance for Android integrity checks, new Exchange Hybrid detail on LES Writeback, and a precise SCIM description of how Entra ID handles mailNickname during user creation.

Entra ID · Authentication

Conditional Access guidance documents Android Play Integrity enforcement

The Assignment Network guidance now says Microsoft Authenticator for Android uses the Google Play Integrity API for jailbreak detection and denies access when the API is unavailable, unless the policy is disabled. Use this detail when troubleshooting blocked Android access under Conditional Access.

Entra ID · General

Exchange Hybrid guidance adds Entra2ADExchangeOnlineAttributeWriteback detail

The article now documents Entra2ADExchangeOnlineAttributeWriteback, also called LES Writeback, including its cloud-managed attribute flow, distinction from Exchange hybrid writeback, supported attributes, mappings, and related guidance.

Entra ID · Standards

SCIM reference clarifies mailNickname creation and PATCH limits

When creating a user, mailNickname may be omitted, null, or empty. Entra ID derives it from the characters before the first @ in userName, and after creation it cannot be removed with PATCH.

Entra ID · Developer

Consent policy examples replace documented application IDs

The Manage App Consent Policies guidance replaces the application IDs shown for Apple Mail, Spark Email, eM Client, Android-Samsung, Android-Mail, and Thunderbird. Administrators using those identifiers in consent-policy rules should verify them against the updated examples.

item.title: Entra self-service identity management shifts to cloud.microsoft worldwide in late November — 26 August 2026
item.description:
Day in brief · 26 August 2026

Entra self-service identity management shifts to cloud.microsoft worldwide in late November

Microsoft Entra will move its self-service identity management domain from myaccount.microsoft.com to myaccount.cloud.microsoft worldwide in late November 2026. Global Secure Access release notes also set out automatic Windows Update upgrades for eligible clients beginning in November, while new App Gallery guidance and revised administration documentation clarify publishing, group creation, and tenant-creation requirements.

Entra ID · General

Self-service identity sites move to cloud.microsoft in late November

Microsoft Entra is updating the self-service identity management domain from myaccount.microsoft.com to myaccount.cloud.microsoft and consolidating related sites. The worldwide rollout is planned for late November 2026; users need no action, but administrators should allow *.cloud.microsoft in network policies.

Global Secure Access · General

Eligible Global Secure Access Windows clients will receive automatic upgrades

Starting in November 2026, eligible Windows clients will receive Global Secure Access upgrades through Windows Update. Version 2.32.294 adds Prefer local network, faster tunnel creation, and other fixes and improvements. Administrators opting out must use the documented installer parameter and maintain updates manually.

Entra ID · General

New App Gallery workflow details validation, submission, and review

A new tutorial documents the self-service publishing workflow: complete validation prerequisites, create a submission, select capabilities, provide required application details, submit for Microsoft review, and track drafts. item.description:

Entra ID · Authentication

System-preferred authentication now covers first-factor sign-ins

Lifecycle Workflow guidance documents 365-day event offsets

The installation page states that client version 1.1.26060207 includes com.microsoft.autoupdate2 and that an existing installation may conflict with Intune detection rules. It advises optionally removing that app from the Included apps list.

item.title: Federated sign-in validation tightens as Windows Hello and macOS SSO gain standalone MFA — 18 August 2026
item.description:
Day in brief · 18 August 2026

Federated sign-in validation tightens as Windows Hello and macOS SSO gain standalone MFA

The day’s consequential changes are two Entra authentication behavior updates. Microsoft says the federatedTokenValidationPolicy default will block federated sign-ins when internalDomainFederation does not match the user’s UPN domain for federated domains configured before December 2025. Starting in October 2026, Windows Hello for Business and macOS Platform SSO will count as standalone MFA factors. Workload ID’s flexible federated identity credential preview guidance also tightens GitHub claim matching, while the remaining updates are lower-impact synchronization and licensing reference maintenance.

External ID · Conditional Access

FederatedTokenValidationPolicy default will block mismatched federated domains

Microsoft’s Message Center notice describes a mid-August 2026 default change affecting federated domains configured before December 2025. Federated sign-ins will be blocked when internalDomainFederation does not match the user’s UPN domain. Administrators can customize the policy through Microsoft Graph, although Microsoft discourages customization.

Entra ID · Conditional Access

Windows Hello and macOS Platform SSO become standalone MFA factors

Starting in October 2026, Microsoft Entra will recognize Windows Hello for Business and macOS Platform SSO as standalone MFA factors, allowing users to satisfy MFA requirements without an additional passkey. Microsoft says no configuration changes are required, but onboarding and MFA-registration guidance should be updated.

Workload ID · Security

GitHub flexible FIC preview guidance requires immutable repository claims

The updated preview documentation says GitHub flexible federated identity credentials must match sub and at least one immutable claim: repository_id or repository_owner_id. The examples and operator guidance now use these claims with the eq operator when defining or reviewing trust.

Entra ID · Provisioning

Synchronization guidance adds sAMAccountName coverage for Domain Services

The Synchronization page now describes enhanced support for synchronizing sAMAccountName with Microsoft Entra Domain Services and links to dedicated guidance for that scenario.

Entra ID · General

Licensing reference adds Windows 10 ESU identifiers to Windows 365 entries

The reference, updated August 14, 2026, adds Windows 10 ESU service-plan identifiers to two Windows 365 plan entries. No administrator action is stated beyond using the updated reference when matching those plans.

item.description:

Global Secure Access guidance details guided V1-to-V2 web filtering migration

The main substantive addition is a new Global Secure Access how-to for migrating eligible web content filtering policies from V1 to V2. The existing Web Filtering page now links to that guidance. Separate Entra ID and ID Protection updates clarify documented limitations and remediation behavior rather than announcing new features.

Global Secure Access · General

New guidance maps V1 web filtering policies into V2 rules

The Global Secure Access migration guide covers eligible and ineligible security profiles, naming, and the guided migration process. Each V1 policy becomes a rule in one enabled V2 policy while preserving destinations, actions, and priorities. Profiles that already contain V2 policies require manual handling, and evaluation across multiple security profiles differs between V1 and V2.

Authentication-strength guidance excludes MSA-authenticated external users

Updated Entra ID guidance states that authentication-strength policies cannot currently be applied to external users authenticating through Microsoft personal (MSA) accounts. ID Protection revises the documented device-block remediation behavior

The updated guidance says disabling the Entra device blocks new token issuance, revokes user sessions, and prompts the user to sign in again. It no longer mentions revoking existing device-bound refresh tokens, making this a documentation clarification rather than evidence of a behavior change.

item.description:

External ID on-behalf-of ordering targets Dynamics 365 Commerce general availability on 11 September 2026

The clearest product announcement is a Microsoft 365 Message Center notice that on-behalf-of ordering for Dynamics 365 Commerce with Microsoft Entra External ID is scheduled for general availability on 11 September 2026. A new Microsoft Entra Internet Access article documents the V2 web-filtering model and its coexistence with V1. External ID · General

On-behalf-of ordering gets a scheduled External ID availability milestone

Internet Access · Fundamentals

V2 web filtering is documented as a distinct Internet Access model

The new Global Secure Access V2 article describes one policy per security profile, multiple rules with individual actions, a default action, and URL-based FQDN destinations. Existing V1 web-content-filtering policies continue to function until migration. The new article documents the model but does not by itself establish a separate availability milestone.

Entra ID · Authentication

Staged Rollout guidance now details additional sign-in scenarios

The Microsoft Entra Connect article replaces general transition language with scenarios involving extra interactive sign-ins when users are added to or removed from Staged Rollout, including certain Microsoft Entra ID Protection remediation events such as SSPR and risk remediation. The supported administrator outcome is better troubleshooting guidance, not evidence of a newly changed sign-in behavior.

Optional Claims guidance clarifies granular AMR configuration paths

The updated article explains that SAML applications must configure the `include_granular_amr` setting through the application manifest or Microsoft Graph because the admin center has no corresponding UI. It also documents adding the `amr` optional claim for OIDC token types and clarifies that `include_granular_amr` applies only to SAML.

Entra ID · Provisioning

Puzzel provisioning adds OAuth2 client-credentials instructions

The Puzzel integration guide now covers OAuth2 Client Credentials Grant authentication, including creating an OIDC client, setting 3600-second token lifetimes, generating a shared secret, and entering the client ID, secret, and token endpoint. This is connector-specific setup guidance rather than a new general provisioning capability.

Retirement: custom CSS positioning in Microsoft Entra company branding

Microsoft Entra ID will retire support for custom CSS positioning properties in company branding starting in October 2026 as a security and phishing-resistance measure. Existing users must remove those properties, with no migration path provided; branding elements will remain visible but can return to default placement.

Entra ID · Conditional Access

Changed behavior: Conditional Access enforcement for resource exclusions

A Message Center notice states that, starting 15 June 2026, Conditional Access policies targeting All resources with exclusions will be enforced for sign-ins requesting only certain OIDC or directory scopes. Custom applications using only those requests may encounter new challenges such as MFA. Because the stated date precedes this reporting period, affected app owners should evaluate current sign-in behavior; the notice says most organizations need no action.

The evidence describes a procedural documentation expansion, not a stated preview, GA, or service-behavior change.

A new architecture-guidance set introduces common tenant patterns intended to help organizations meet requirements with as few tenants as possible. Companion guidance covers primary production, nonproduction multitenant environments, collaborating production tenants, business-partner access, critical business systems, and hybrid identity and isolation. It is design guidance for comparing architectural options, not evidence of a mandatory tenant restructuring.

Internet Access · General

item.title: Existing FIDO2 tenants face automatic passkey-profile migration as Entra broadens passkey GA — 21 July 2026
item.description:
Day in brief · 21 July 2026

Existing FIDO2 tenants face automatic passkey-profile migration as Entra broadens passkey GA

The period is driven by two distinct passkey changes: tenant-side migration to passkey profiles and general availability of Entra passkeys on Windows. It also introduces a network-layer Microsoft Purview DLP integration through Entra Internet Access and replaces legacy CAPTCHA protection in self-service password reset with backend abuse detection.

Entra ID · Authentication

Passkey profiles and existing FIDO2 configurations move to general availability

For tenants with Passkeys (FIDO2) enabled, Microsoft Entra is making passkey profiles and synced passkeys generally available. Existing configurations migrate to a Default passkey profile with a new passkeyType property, while automatic migration and registration-campaign updates roll out regionally through October 2026. This is a tenant-configuration behavior change, not merely a documentation update.

ID Protection · Conditional Access

Microsoft Purview DLP extends to the network layer through Entra Internet Access

The integration enables inspection and protection of sensitive data in AI interactions and cloud services at the network layer, with policy enforcement, alerts, and auditing. The rollout is scheduled from July through October 2026 and spans Microsoft Purview, Microsoft Entra, and Defender administration.

Entra ID · Conditional Access

Microsoft Entra passkeys on Windows reach general availability

The Windows capability is generally available from late April 2026, providing phishing-resistant, passwordless sign-in on corporate, personal, and shared Windows devices without explicit opt-in. Administrators can control the capability through Authentication Methods policies and Conditional Access; the notice says no action is needed unless blocking is desired.

Entra ID · Authentication

SSPR replaces legacy CAPTCHA with backend abuse detection

Beginning in early August 2026, self-service password reset replaces legacy CAPTCHA with backend throttling and behavior-based abuse detection. The change is intended to improve security and accessibility while preserving current password-reset functionality, with no new controls and no user or administrator action required.
